```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 10_confidence_intervals_ci
title: >
  Calculate the CI
questions:
  - id: single_sample_ci
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      A sample mean is 322.59, the standard error of the mean is 10.43, and the
      95% boundary z value is 1.96. What is the approximate confidence interval?
    answer: >
      The interval is 322.59 +/- 1.96 * 10.43, or about [302, 343].
    explanation: >
      The margin of error is the boundary z value multiplied by the standard
      error of the mean.
```
